title: Ziyarat of Imam Al Hujjah (a.t.f.s.)
data:
بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ
BISMILLAAHIR RAHMAANIR RAHEEM
In the Name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ الْحَسَنِ الْحُجَّةَ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA MUHAMMADABNAL HASANIL HUJJAH
Peace be upon you, O Muhammad son of al-Hasan, the Proof.
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا صَاحِبَ الْاَمْرِ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA SAHIBAL AMR
Peace be upon you, O the leader of the affair.
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا صَاحِبَ التَّدْبِيْرِ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA SAHIBAT TADBEER
Peace be upon you, the director of the affairs.
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلَانَا يَا صَاحِبَ الزَّمَانِ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA MAWLAANAA YAA SAAHIBAZ ZAMAAN
Peace be upon you, O master, the leader of the time.
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ اَيُّهَا الْاِمَامُ الْمُنْتَظَرُ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA AYYUHAL IMAAMUL MUNTAZAR
Peace be upon you, O the awaited Imam.
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ اَيُّهَا الْقَآئِمُ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA AYYUHAL QAAA'IM
Peace be upon you, the establisher of Allah's law.
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ اَيُّهَا الْخَلَفُ الصَّالِحُ لِلْاَئِمَّةِ الْمَعْصُوْمِيْنَ الْمُطَهَّرِيْنَ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA AYYUHAL KHALAFUS SAALIHU LIL-A'IMMATIL MA'SOOMEENAL MUTAHHAREEN
Peace be upon you, the righteous successor of the pure and infallible Imams.
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اِمَامَ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA IMAAMAL MUSLIMEEN
Peace be upon you, O leader of the Muslims.
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَلِيَّ اللّٰهِ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA WALIYYALLAAH
Peace be upon you, O representative of Allah.
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خَلِيْفَةَ رَسُوْلِ اللّٰهِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهٖ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA KHALEEFATA RASOOLILLAAHI SALLALLAAHU A'LAYHI WA AALIH
Peace be upon you, O successor of the Messenger of Allah — Allah's blessings be upon him and his Household.
merits: To be recited whenever you are scared and in difficulties.
